subject: Inglese
title: 1. Do, does, did oppure to be?

items.title: La domanda da farsi sempre
items.html:
Prima di scegliere, guarda se nella frase c'è un altro verbo che dice cosa si fa (go, play, eat, see…).

• C'è un altro verbo → l'ausiliare è do / does / did.
• Non c'è nessun altro verbo → il verbo è to be: am / is / are / was / were.

did e was non vanno mai insieme. Did you were non esiste.

items.title: Presente o passato
items.html:
Presente: do / does  —  am / is / are
Passato: did (per tutti)  —  was / were

items.lab: C'è un altro verbo? No → to be
items.why: Nella frase non c'è nessun altro verbo, quindi il verbo è to be al passato: Where were you yesterday?

items.lab: C'è un altro verbo? Sì → did
items.why: Qui c'è il verbo go, quindi serve l'ausiliare: Where did you go yesterday?
Non c'è altro verbo: happy è un aggettivo. Was she happy?
C'è il verbo work e siamo al passato: Did she work here last year?
Nessun altro verbo → to be: He was not at school yesterday.
C'è il verbo go → did not: He did not go to school yesterday.
C'è il verbo live, presente, soggetto they: Do they live in Udine?
He, she, it al presente vogliono does: Does your sister play tennis?
Non c'è altro verbo e parents è plurale: Are your parents at home?

items.prompt: We ___ very tired after the match.
items.why: We vuole were. Was si usa con I, he, she, it.

items.prompt: I ___ at the stadium on Sunday.
items.why: Con I al passato si usa was: I was at the stadium on Sunday.

items.prompt: What ___ you eat for lunch yesterday?
items.why: C'è il verbo eat: What did you eat for lunch yesterday?
Nessun altro verbo → to be: What is your favourite colour?

options: Did you go to the party?
Did you went to the party?
Were you go to the party?
Do you went to the party?
items.answer: Did you go to the party?
items.why: Dopo did il verbo torna alla forma base: did + go, mai did + went.

options: She was at home yesterday did.
items.why: Con she si usa was, e non serve nessun altro ausiliare.

items.prompt: Did you see the film? — Yes, I ___.
items.why: Nelle risposte brevi si ripete l'ausiliare della domanda: Yes, I did.

items.prompt: Were you at the party? — Yes, I ___.
items.why: La domanda usa to be, quindi si risponde con was: Yes, I was.
